note: Drive Schultz Pass Rd to Elden Lookout Rd; dirt starts at a gate about 1.9 mi in, and a pullout on the right at about 2.3 mi holds roughly five cars. If the gate is locked, park and walk the road about five minutes to the pullout.
basis: MP Oaklands Getting There: 'The road turns to dirt at 1.9 miles, before a gate. At 2.3 miles, a pullout on the right fits about five cars... When the gate is locked, park and walk the road for five minutes.'

note: Park at the cul-de-sac at the end of Paradise (off Linda Vista, a block or two north of the Safeway at Cedar Ave); do not park in front of the gated chain-link fence, out of courtesy to residents.
basis: MP Solitude Canyon: 'For The Solitude Wall park at the same cul de sac at the end of Paradise that you would to access Glorias Boulders.' Don't park in front of the chain-link fence with the gate.

note: Sheepshead parking area is the first one, about 0.4 mi from the Forest Road 687 junction; free primitive camping there. The approach road is rough dirt, so drive carefully in a passenger car.
basis: MP West Stronghold: '0.4 miles - Sheepshead parking area, free primitive camping.' (mileage from FR 687 intersection); road 'can be rough'.

note: Park about 2.0 mi along Forest Road 687 from the Middlemarch Rd junction at the Sweet Rock / Isle of Ewe pullout area; free primitive camping. The road is rough dirt.
basis: MP West Stronghold: '2.0 miles - Sweet Rock, Isle of You (Ewe), free primitive camping.'

note: Park at the signed Warpath Dome approach parking about 6.5 mi up the rough Forest Road 687 from the junction; high clearance helps and road damage to cars is possible.
basis: MP West Stronghold: '6.5 miles - Parking for Warpath dome approach.' Page warns 'Your car can be damaged on this road'.

note: Drive to the end of the road (about 10 mi past the Forest Road 687 junction) and park at the circular lot, which serves Westworld and Whale Domes; free primitive camping. The road is rough, so drive carefully.
basis: MP West Stronghold: '10.1 miles - end of the road. Parking for Whale Dome, Westworld Dome, Paleface, Ghost Dome, and Squaretop.'

note: Drive to the end of the road (about 10 mi past the Forest Road 687 junction) and park at the circular lot, which serves Whale and Westworld Domes; free primitive camping. The road is rough, so drive carefully.
basis: MP West Stronghold: '10.1 miles - end of the road. Parking for Whale Dome, Westworld Dome, Paleface, Ghost Dome, and Squaretop.'

note: Park in the large paved lot at Key's Corner (Wonderland trailhead area). Hike north on a well-defined trail; this is a long approach of about an hour.
basis: MP Siberia Getting There: 'Park in the large paved lot at Key's Corner and hike north following a well-defined trail.'
